The institutional investor held 10,454 shares of the commercial banks company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $953,000, up from 7,129 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ativo Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Banco De Chile Sp Adr for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $16.26B market cap company.
